CMT-06.method: After CMT-08's comment, added a second comment '**bold** and https://example.com' in each app, then opened the task's own activity view (Todoist: More actions -> View activity; meologue: the Activity panel) and read every activity line verbatim. Note: Todoist's activity dialog needed a close+reopen to pick up the second comment's event -- the first read after posting only showed the events dialog's stale event count (2); closing and reopening it updated the count to 3 and surfaced the new 'commented bold and https://example.com' line. This is a read-refresh quirk of Todoist's own UI, not a measurement gap.
